test_title: PYST 69: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A milkman bought 90 litres of milk for Rs. 1,630 and added 15 litres of water. If he sells it at Rs. 19.00 per litre, his profit percentage will be:
solution:
**Given**

Cost of milk = Rs. 1630 for 90 litres

Added water = 15 litres

Selling price = Rs. 19.00 per litre

**Concept:**

Profit percentage = (Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price × 100%

**Solution:**

⇒ Total volume = 90 litres + 15 litres = 105 litres

⇒ Total selling price = 105 litres × Rs. 19.00 per litre = Rs. 1995

⇒ Profit percentage = (Rs. 1995 - Rs. 1630)/Rs. 1630 × 100%

⇒ Profit percentage = 22 (64)/(163) \%

**Hence, the profit percentage is 22 (64)/(163) \%.**
